_doc: TuRu - SEMANTIC layer for the flat category strings in categoryValues.json (Phase A+B+C, 2026-09-21).
categoryValues.json stays the source of truth for WHICH strings are legal; this file says what a
few of them MEAN, what a user may call them, and how a classifier should tell them apart.
dbValue is the value actually stored in activities.category. It is deliberately NOT renamed when
the product label changes - 'פארק שעשועים' remains the stored value for ATTRACTION_COMPLEX while
the product concept is displayed as 'מתחם אטרקציות' (see lib/i18n/locales/*/domain.json). Renaming
persisted values needs a dedicated, dry-runnable data phase, not a code edit.
MIRROR: supabase/functions/_shared/categorySemantics.json is a byte-identical copy (Edge Functions
deploy as a self-contained bundle and cannot import from the repo root - the same deliberate-copy
arrangement categoryValues.json already uses). tests/categorySemantics.test.js fails if they drift.
PRIMARY EXPERIENCE is the governing principle for every concept here: what is the visitor mainly
there to do. Size, ticketing, popularity and 'being a destination' are NOT classification signals.
recallAliases: the subset of aliases specific enough to be TEXT evidence about a record (the soft
recall channel in lib/filterActivities.js). Deliberately narrower than aliases: a bare generic
word like "פארק" is a fine thing for a USER to type, but a terrible thing to conclude a record
FROM - plenty of venue names contain it without being public parks ("גרביטי פארק"). An empty
list means the concept recalls on its stored category only.

PARK.definition: A public or municipal recreational park. Primary experience: open green space - walking, lawns, picnics, trails, spending time outdoors. A park may contain playground equipment, a petting corner or a water feature and still be primarily a PARK.

PLAYGROUND.definition: A children's playground. Primary experience: children playing on playground equipment. Typically free, unstaffed and open to the public, often inside a larger park or neighbourhood.

ATTRACTION_COMPLEX.definition: An amusement / ride / entertainment attraction complex. Primary experience: rides and built entertainment installations - rollercoasters, ferris wheels, bumper cars, carousels, or a comparable dedicated entertainment attraction. Requires an actual ride/entertainment-installation signal. A venue is NOT an attraction complex merely because it is large, ticketed, popular with families, a destination, or made of several experiences.

ANIMALS_ZOO.definition: A destination whose PRIMARY experience is seeing, observing or interacting with animals at zoo / safari / aquarium / wildlife-park scale. Being large, ticketed or multi-activity is irrelevant - an animal destination that also has rides, lawns or a cafe is still an animal destination.

PETTING_CORNER.definition: A small petting / animal corner - a compact animal area, usually INSIDE something else (a park, a school, a community centre). Distinguished from ANIMALS_ZOO by scale and by not being a destination in its own right.

FARM.definition: A working / agricultural farm experience. Primary experience is farm life and agriculture - picking, milking, tractors, fields - not viewing collected animals.

_animalsNote: RESOLVED 2026-09-21 (Phase E): חיות וגני חיות is now a CANONICAL category (added to
categoryValues.json) and is implemented above as ANIMALS_ZOO. The three animal concepts are
deliberately kept SEPARATE and must never be auto-merged:
ANIMALS_ZOO (חיות וגני חיות) - a destination built around animals (zoo/safari/aquarium).
PETTING_CORNER (פינת חי)     - a small animal corner, usually inside something else.
Each lists the others under negativeSignals/notEvidence, so no one of them can absorb another.
The bare words חיות / בעלי חיים are notEvidence for ALL THREE on purpose: they appear constantly
in workshops, story hours and event copy that have no animal venue behind them at all.
The legacy בעלי חיים category (13 production rows) is TRANSITIONAL and is not modelled here -
its rows split across the three concepts above during the later cleanup phase. Likewise אטרקציה
(35 rows) is transitional and is NOT equivalent to ATTRACTION_COMPLEX - the Phase D audit found
only 2 of its 35 rows are ride-based; the dominant real meaning is adventure/extreme experiences.
